title: Ext is homology of a termwise identified signed dual resolution
statement: Let A be a commutative ring with a derived category for its module category, X,Y A-modules, and P a projective resolution of X. Let L be a nonnegative cochain complex of A-modules, with A-module isomorphisms e_i:L_i -> Hom_A(P_i,Y). Suppose e_(i+1) composed with the differential of L equals (-1)^(i+1) times precomposition with the differential P_(i+1) -> P_i, after e_i, for every i. For every natural n there is an A-linear equivalence Ext^n_A(X,Y) -> H^n(L).

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, total Hom computation, generalized to any projective resolution; Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and Cochain.delta_toSingleMk

proof.text: Apply the pinned Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass, which gives Ext as cocycles modulo coboundaries from P.cochainComplex to Y[0]. This is an existing comparison, not the old right-derived Ext functor of Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.

Evaluate degree-n cochains at the sole possible component P_n -> Y via Cochain.toSingleEquiv and P.cochainComplexXIso. Cochain.δ_toSingleMk gives differential (-1)^(n+1) times precomposition with d_(n+1). The term isomorphisms e and equation hd identify cycles and boundaries with those of L, so induce an additive quotient equivalence. At n=0 the preceding component is zero since P.cochainComplex is zero in positive degrees. Explicitly send a cocycle to e_n inverse applied to its evaluated component. In the other direction apply e_n to an L-cycle and insert it with Cochain.toSingleMk in degree -n. Equation hd proves the cocycle condition and identifies the images of the preceding differential in both directions; hence these inverse linear maps descend to inverse maps on homology.

Represent every Ext class as P.extMk g using extMk_surjective. Ext.smul_eq_comp_mk₀ and extMk_comp_mk₀ identify a times that class with extMk of g followed by a times id_Y, namely a*g. Evaluation, e, and the quotient maps are linear, so the additive equivalence preserves scalars and gives the stated linear equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem exists_ext_signed_dual_homology_equiv (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] {X Y : ModuleCat.{u} A} (P : ProjectiveResolution X) (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℕ) (e : ∀ i, L.X i ≅ ModuleCat.of A (P.complex.X i ⟶ Y)) (hd : ∀ i, L.d i (i + 1) ≫ (e (i + 1)).hom = (e i).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom ((-1 : A) ^ (i + 1) • Linear.leftComp A Y (P.complex.d (i + 1) i))) (n : ℕ) : Nonempty (Abelian.Ext X Y n ≃ₗ[A] L.homology n)
